objectiveRefs.description: Distinguish the measured E-to-B and E-to-H ratios by SI dimensions before substituting material formulas.
Compute the independent speed and impedance predictions and compare them with the measured ratios.
Check B0 = mu0 mu_r H0 and identify permeability as a dimensional constitutive factor.

misconceptionConceptRefs.description: Treating E/B as an impedance instead of a speed.
Treating B and H as numerically or dimensionally interchangeable.
